messages.subject: Series B fundraise — instructing you
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi Sarah,

We've signed a term sheet in principle with Brindley Growth Partners to lead our Series B — c. £18m at a £60m post. We'd like Whitfield Carter to act for the company. Can you send your engagement terms and a proposed timetable? Marcus (CFO) and Priya (our GC) will be your main contacts alongside me.

Thanks,
Anita

messages.plaintextBody:
Anita — delighted to act. Engagement letter attached for signature. James Osei will be day-to-day lead with Elena Marchetti supporting. On timetable, allowing one round of negotiation per document we'd expect to reach completion in 8–10 weeks, so early March. We'll need access to the data room and the current cap table to get going.

--
